parametrized_description: A park is designing their trails and can either create a wide trail or a narrow trail. A wide trail can take WideCapacity visitors every day while the narrow trail expects NarrowCapacity visitors every day. The wide trail will introduce WideGarbage units of garbage and the narrow trail will introduce NarrowGarbage units of garbage. There can be at most MaxWideTrails wide trails and the park hopes to have at most MaxCapacity visitors every day. How many of each type of trail should the park construct to minimize the total amount of garbage produced.

MaxWideTrails.description: Maximum number of wide trails allowed

MaxVisitorsPerDay.description: Maximum number of visitors allowed per day

VisitorsPerWideTrail.description: Number of visitors per day on a wide trail

VisitorsPerNarrowTrail.description: Number of visitors per day on a narrow trail

GarbagePerWideTrail.description: Units of garbage produced per wide trail

GarbagePerNarrowTrail.description: Units of garbage produced per narrow trail

NumWideTrails.description: Number of wide trails to construct

NumNarrowTrails.description: Number of narrow trails to construct

constraints.description: Number of wide trails is non-negative
Number of narrow trails is non-negative
Number of wide trails does not exceed MaxWideTrails
Total visitors every day does not exceed MaxVisitorsPerDay

code.gurobipy: model.addConstr(VisitorsPerWideTrail * NumWideTrails + VisitorsPerNarrowTrail * NumNarrowTrails <= MaxVisitorsPerDay, name="MaxVisitorsConstr")

objective.description: Minimize the total amount of garbage produced by the trails
